caption: The drawing features a wooden rocking chair with a dark brown color, depicted in a three-quarter view that shows the front, side, and part of the seat. The backrest of the chair is upholstered with a textured material, likely leather, that is dark in color and fastened with metallic tacks or studs along its border. The seat appears to be woven or padded with a reddish-brown material. The wooden frame of the chair includes curved rockers at the bottom, turned spindles below the armrests, and decorative elements at the top of the backrest, such as a geometric carved pattern and small round spindles. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a technical line drawing of a mechanical detail, likely related to the chair’s construction, shown in black ink without any color fill. The background of the entire image is a plain light beige.
title: Child's Rocking Chair
